  FROM sm_item_disassembly h
 WHERE h.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IDAguardIn.data.tenantId}}'
   AND h.id = {{node:code_node_IDAguardIn.data.idaId}}
   AND h.is_deleted = 0
